scope: IQ tolerance/damping values selected by native AecClmExecute through complete control return, including controller state and diagnostics
limitations: Profile fields are injected into their recovered context slots; this is not complete native calibration-loader equivalence.
Runtime alternate flag +0x23ce and convergence gating flag are explicit; alternate-flag producer remains external.
Uniform selected tolerance is bound; other runtime policy, limits, dynamics/delay calibration and hardware writes are not added.
Half the cases deliberately change tolerances and all four damping coefficients to distinguish selector branches.
